It's not too bad for a BR. Or at least, I get kills so I like it. The spiderman-like hook travel mechanic is interesting, and I like how you can edit most characters' appearance straight away. Gotta buy lootboxes for clothes, but hey, it's a BR.

Pros:
Extremely fun once you get all the mechanics down
Lots of combos and variety in weapons and fighting styles
Not a BR that's focused on winning
Super nice customization

Cons:
Not easy to pick up and extremely hard difficulty curve
Latency issues can screw both parties over in a fight (even if you have good latency)
A pretty aggressive free to play strategy with a lot of micro transactions and lootboxes (That being said it is NOT pay to win, all of the transactions are for cosmetics)

overall would recommend, the cons are not deal breakers for me

Look. The gameplay itself is amazing. The Smash/Brawlhalla type of combat, a dozen of weapons with cool movesets, amazing parkour and an interesting map.

But if I had to pick ONE game with the worst matchmaking ever, it would be Naraka. Literally every match is "95% players are bots, the other 5% are (I'm not exaggerating) some sort of top 1000 players of the previous season or tournament winners."

I wanted to enjoy Naraka but it's impossible.

P.S. Also, thousands of cosmetic(and often ugly) microtransactions
Not the first person to say it; You'll never play a game quite like this one.

This game really itches my need to just beat people up! such a different BR type, melee battle is my passion and all the graphics, outfits and settings are beautiful. There's always events going on, a BP and season as well so constant loot and gifts without spending real money ( ofc all the GREAT stuff is to pay) but I'm content.

Now then there's a few things weird/strange with the game tho. for one, the recent players list does not work, hasn't worked for over a year. hell I don't think its ever worked TBH so that's a huge downer. Missed so many opportunities to add people I've bonded with in match v.v

Secondly there's a global chat option and yet we haven't been able to ever use it to chat?? I heard it was taken down due to people being rude. But then why even have it as a tab then?? its been years now since its worked just get rid of it.

Other than that Its been such a blast and fun. just wished they would address these issues rather than just ignoring them and for some reason not taking it out of game if they never intend on doing something with it.

You'll get about 50fps with constant freezes on a mid range PC (note: every graphic setting on low)
I also loved having max of 20FPS whenever I entered the damaging zone, pretty sure the developers intended to make the zone slow down time but it just lagged instead.
I would NOT recommend this game at it's current state, the game is full of Chinese players which end up killing you within one combo.

I don't often write reviews but I felt really compelled to after playing Naraka. God dang this game is fun. The level of depth it has with it's glyph system is seriously impressive and makes playing the game so much more enjoyable knowing that you're working towards some badass progression. The cosmetics are absolutely out of this world too. One of the deepest cosmetic/customizable character systems I've seen in a battle royale yet.

The combat is not perfect, but it still makes for some incredibly rewarding and awesome moments. The hero ultimates are diverse and unique, looting is a breeze and doesn't feel like a drag or the focus of the game, and overall, it just seems like this game is such a bargain for $20. I'm really having a blast so far and can't wait to see what new characters, maps, cosmetics, shit, EVERYTHING this game has to offer in its lifetime.

The game features bots — and not just any bots, but surprisingly strong ones. However, that’s not really a downside; it actually adds to the challenge. This is a high skill–based game where success comes from improving your technique and mastering the mechanics. Many players tend to quit early, often before truly getting good — but for those who stick with it, the payoff is worth it.

You get nice weapon/martial arts , very nice skins, and gain access to new heroes, keeping the experience fresh and rewarding

Amazing community driven game in the battle royal style, but staying faithful to melee weapons, fun combat involving counters, blocking, ultimate moves, skill moves, and combos. Really enjoyable as a casual game if you don't want to try hard in other games or want to just chill a little after a stressful day. Community is also very friendly, compared to many other MMOs, this one actually gets the feel right. Even the ranking system is good as they have global, regional, county/province and city based ranking/stats seperately, it gives you a clear goal.

Fun melee based Battle Royal with a PVE and training modes that allow for practice with each hero and weapon. Somewhat new-player friendly as well, at least in trios or duos, solo modes are a different story. Surprisingly in depth mechanics easy to learn with steep mastering curve. I do think the game leans a little too much on what I would call "anime-isms" with cosmetics, emotes, poses, and voice-lines (though still high quality). The menu's are confusing at first and I think there are way too many of them. The rewards are plentiful and leveling up feels satisfying. Overall a 7(7.5)/10 definitely worth a try but I realize this kind of game isn't for everyone.
The combat is fairly hard to master but it's fun once you know what you're doing!

We tried many battle royale and there is always the same problem. A few days on release its fun, all players with a gigantic player base start sameish good, you win, you loose, you have fun and learn the game. This shifts very fast, especially for shooters, where casual gaming is not possible anymore. You can't simply start Apex now, when you're not already fantastic in delivering head shots in under a second (Im not, I play stuff like Borderlands and can aim a weapon straight, but nothing fancy). You are getting eaten alive. and I don't want to make a battle royale my life, I want to play a match or two every now and then.

But not with Naraka, where the playstyle is way more RPGish and very casual friendly. We played this to release and just came back. And its fun. The start is easy with a bot and real player mix, you get more and more real people as you get better and everybody can enjoy a somewhat of success feeling before meeting the 3000h+ giga chads that kill you in an instant.

The characters are fun, there are many maps and events. You can get better with in game tutorials and training. Simply a very balanced expierience.

I was introduced to this game through Bloody Spell. Ultimately, I don't like or recommend Naraka: Bladepoint because of one fundamental problem: the bosses will eventually remove your access and take away everything you own in the game because it's online-only. Like many online-only games, their servers shut down once profit or player base drops.

This game is the only BR game I really enjoyed.
The skill requirement is massive. It is not a hack-and-slash game unless you enjoy losing your weapon and half your health.

The movement can be insane if you know how to and watching a top player play, you will feel like you never played a fighting game before.

Unfortunately, there isn't a big player base. It is mostly bots you will play against except maybe during weekends when you're around mid gold and under. When you're above that, GL because thats where the real fight begins.
But be warned, bots can easily kill you aswell but can exploit some of their program.

After playing the game for at least nearly a month I can say that you should not take into account players' reviews. I have seen so many of them being negative, when this game has so much to offer! If you like Battle Royals with different kind of weapons from the Katana to the Great Sword but also Daggers and so much more you should most definitely try this game!

The game has legit amazing skins for the weapons! Obviously, you gotta cash to get some of the rarest ones, but a lot of them are free and quite easy to obtain! They stream often on twitch and offer them twitch drops so make sure you check this out!

They hooked up me and my friends during the Free to play Weekend and we instantly bought it! (Got lucky it was 50% off!)

TIP: Don't think the game is easy, after you grind the ranks you will see the real level of this game. Some INSANE players! Don't quit, just practice and get better!

See you soon in Naraka!
